mapper.sql: select t.*, w.warehouse_name as warehouse_name, m.material_code as material_code, m.material_name as material_name, m.specification as specification, m.unit as unit from erp_inventory_balance t left join erp_warehouse w on w.id = t.warehouse_id left join erp_material m on m.id = t.material_id
mapper.insert: insert into erp_inventory_balance (warehouse_id, material_id, available_quantity, average_cost, inventory_amount, last_business_time, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{warehouseId}, #{materialId}, #{availableQuantity}, #{averageCost}, #{inventoryAmount}, #{lastBusinessTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from erp_inventory_balance where id in #{id}
